results.occurrenceRemarks: Observed at the metered parking area over the railing at Hornsey Road - it was moving quickly as wild boars were fighting nearby (observed a few minutes ago at the railing, then heard noises), then paused on the concrete. Moved quickly back to wild boar area when a car drove by and startled it into raising its quills (last 2 photos). My first time seeing a porcupine and it was impressive to see one in such an urban area. Bigger than expected, about 2.5 feet long.
